items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tommy and I did two together. Those were a pleasure.

ctx.x: Were you pleased with them musically?

Not particularly. The one that I was most pleased with was the one with John Lewis. Also there was the one…Tommy and I did two together. Those were a pleasure. I enjoyed those. One was done in Germany, and the other was done in California. That was in Berkeley.
You know, just jumping around, a date that really intrigued me, and I don't have the recording, but it is a recording that you did with some African musicians.
